item.title: Drake Is Hosting Apology Parties for Anyone Named Janice in Several Cities: ‘Look Out for My Invitation’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. Today, we're talking about Drake and his latest gesture to make amends with all the Janices out there. You see, his hit song 'Janice STFU' told people with that name to, well, pipe down. But now, he's saying sorry in a big way."
[Music transitions to a quick clip of "Janice STFU"]
Host: "Drake's announced that he's hosting Janice-only parties across North America, in cities like NYC, Los Angeles, Miami, Toronto, and Houston. And if you're a Janice, you'll be getting an exclusive invite this Sunday. In fact, the party in Toronto is already set for this Sunday at the Cactus Club, from 1 to 4 pm ET. But don't forget your government ID with the name 'Janice' on it, because that's the only way you'll get in."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "The song 'Janice STFU' was a huge hit, landing Drake his 14th number one spot on the Billboard Hot 100 chart. And it's interesting to note that the 'Janice' in the song is actually inspired by Tony Soprano's sister from the hit HBO show The Sopranos. The track's producer, Rogét Chahayed, is a huge fan of the show, and he said it was a full-circle moment for him to work on a Sopranos-inspired track with one of the greatest artists of all time."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one."
